recommended_approach: Use Mantaflow via Blender’s Fluid settings API: configure a GAS fluid Domain (settings on `bpy.types.FluidDomainSettings`) plus at least one Flow object (settings on `bpy.types.FluidFlowSettings`), then add small-scale detail using the domain’s noise-related settings (the API exposes `noise_strength`, `noise_time_anim`, and `noise_type`, and the flow exposes `noise_texture`). Bake the simulation caches using the fluid bake operators (queried in the doc bundle as `bpy.ops.fluid.bake_data` / `bpy.ops.fluid.bake_noise` / `bpy.ops.fluid.bake`) so the result is deterministic and renderable in Cycles.

noise_strength.doc_basis: Mentioned as an attribute on `bpy.types.FluidDomainSettings` (domain noise detail control).

noise_time_anim.doc_basis: Mentioned as an attribute on `bpy.types.FluidDomainSettings` (noise time animation control).

noise_type.doc_basis: Mentioned as an attribute on `bpy.types.FluidDomainSettings` (noise type selection).

noise_texture.doc_basis: Mentioned as an attribute on `bpy.types.FluidFlowSettings` (flow-level noise texture input).
